Chapter 971  Chapter 27 The New Supreme (Please Subscribe)

The shudders of the River of Time are merely confined to a few hundred nearby universes. And only at the River of Time shores of Lin Yuan's universe is the trembling most pronounced.

As for the River of Time of the hundreds of surrounding universes? Just a slight wobble.

In fact, every newly-promoted twelve-layer ascension causes similar phenomena, only far less intense than that of Lin Yuan.

The disturbance caused by Lin Yuan's ascension exceeded the limits of his universe's River of Time, radiating influence to hundreds of neighboring universes.

This led to the shock in the hearts of the twelve-layer Ultimates within hundreds of universes, as they had not seen anyone ascending at the banks of their own universe's River of Time.

But such trembling and shaking coming from the riverbank? This was yet another sign of a new Ultimate's ascension!

...

The twelve-layer Ultimates within the nearby hundred universes were puzzled, as they had no idea about the origin of the shaking at the riverbank.

But the various twelve-layer alien races, who were waiting for the Galaxy Master to ascend at the riverside, were completely baffled.

They had hoped to catch a glimpse of the Galaxy Master's strengths during his ascension, to determine how to face the human civilization, and how to face the Galaxy Master in the future.

They indeed saw some capabilities of the Galaxy Master, but it scared all the twelve-layer Ultimates.

"Such a massive body size? How robust is the life essence of the Galaxy Master..." the mind of a member of the Star Alliance Ultimate was horrified.

The size displayed along the River of Time banks is not as simple as mere multiples.

If my life essence is double yours, then my size at the riverbank is also double yours.

It doesn't work like that.

The rules at the River of Time banks are extremely strict, and having doubled life essence translates here to barely slightly taller.

So, many of the twelve-layer Ultimates at the bank, except for the two from the Robber Clan at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, are more or less the same size.

Even the Xuanyuan Supremes and Myriad Transformation Queens, who are near the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, appear just like other twelve-layer Ultimates.

But Lin Yuan?

Their body heights, these twelve-layer Ultimates, only reached his knees.

Perhaps Lin Yuan could casually walk over and accidentally kick them, even that would be enough to severely injure these twelve-layer Ultimates.

"Peak of Path Splitting Realm, even at the peak, could it really be such a gigantic body size?" Several twelve-layer Ultimates trembled with fear.

Before Lin Yuan stepped into the twelve layers, they had anticipated that the Galaxy Master, after becoming Ultimate, would be extremely terrifying in combat.

But who could imagine this level of terror?

Peak of the Path Splitting Realm? Even the two Ultimates from the Robber Clan who are at the peak come only up to the waist of the Galaxy Master at the River of Time banks.

These twelve-layer Ultimates, in front of Lin Yuan, seem like little children playing house, easily knocked down.

"Are we dealing with the Domain Master? Could the Galaxy Master already be in the Domain Master realm?"

"Impossible, just entering the Path Splitting Realm and already a Domain Master? What kind of logic is that?"

Many twelve-layer beings looked at the slowly ascending Galaxy Master with horrified expressions, rapidly exchanging thoughts.

They had once received information from beyond this universe, aware of the hierarchy within the twelve layers, understanding that above the Path Splitting Realm there are the Domain and Chaos realms.

Given the body size of the Galaxy Master currently, which indeed exceeds their comprehension of the Path Splitting Realm, they unconsciously speculated whether he was in the Domain realm.

"Regardless of what realm the Galaxy Master is now, he is not something we can resist."

The Yu Clan Ultimate collected his thoughts, looking towards the other twelve-layer Ultimates and said, "Following this, our Yu Clan will try to contract our territories as much as possible, you see for yourselves."

With the overwhelming might of the Galaxy Master, who is now invincible within this universe, even if these twelve-layer Ultimates join forces, they cannot resist.

This is why the Yu Clan Ultimate made this decision.

Helpless.

The importance of territory for a peak tribe is self-evident, a vast territory can nurture more life, and more life can give birth to many strong beings, from among the strong, even stronger beings are born, until finally a new twelve-layer Ultimate emerges.

One level leading to another, territory is the foundation for all tribes.

The twelve great peak tribes have been at war for years, just for the sake of cosmic territory.

But as important as a territory is, it's not as vital as the existence of the tribe.

After the Galaxy Master's ascension, he will sweep through the universe with the mightiest posture, during this time if the Yu Clan still occupies a large territory, wouldn't it be seeking death?

"Our tribe should also contract its territory."

"Ah, the days ahead will likely be very tough."

The many twelve-layer Ultimates looked at each other, their expressions filled with sorrow.

The contraction of tribal power, retreating back to the range covered by the power of the Clan Suppression Weapon, by gathering all their strength, there might still be a chance to barely survive.

...

The two Ultimates of the Robber Clan were also watching Lin Yuan's ascension from afar.

"What kind of powerful physique and spirit must one have to nourish such a massive life essence..." one of the Robber Clan Ultimates sighed.

While it's said that life essence isn't directly related to combat power, the stronger the life essence, the more enhanced both attack and defense will be.

One defeating ten isn't just empty talk.

And in the minds of the two Robber Clan Ultimates, they were almost certain that Lin Yuan was the reincarnation of a Great Saint, a reincarnated Great Saint basically means invincibility at the same level, and with such a massive life essence, battling across realms is very normal.

"Our clan should also contract its territory."

After pondering for a moment, the right Robber Clan Ultimate spoke.

"I was thinking the same."

The left Robber Clan Ultimate nodded.
